_: SDD-64 criterion 22: painted pieces (declarative shadow roots, as the server sends them), the same text in happy-dom (outline) and in Chrome (outlineOf). `outline` is what both must write: Chrome's ARIA snapshot, the reference.

pieces.name: a form with label and fieldset
pieces.html: <app-form><template shadowrootmode="open"><form aria-label="Shipping form"><fieldset><legend>Shipping</legend><label for="street">Street</label><input id="street" type="text"><label><input type="checkbox" checked> Gift wrap</label></fieldset><button type="submit">Send</button></form></template></app-form>
pieces.outline:
- form "Shipping form":
  - group "Shipping":
    - text: Shipping Street
    - textbox "Street"
    - checkbox "Gift wrap" [checked]
    - text: Gift wrap
  - button "Send"

pieces.name: content projected into named and unnamed slots
pieces.outline:
- article:
  - heading "Hello card" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Body text

pieces.name: nested components, each with its shadow root
pieces.outline:
- main:
  - tablist:
    - tab "Tab A" [selected]
    - tab "Tab B"
  - tabpanel: panel A

pieces.name: a checked checkbox and a mixed one
a link and a list
pieces.outline:
- navigation "Main":
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - link "Home":
        - /url: /home
    - listitem:
      - link "About us":
        - /url: /about
- paragraph: Loose words

pieces.name: pressed, mixed, and checkboxes that say their state in aria
pieces.html: <ui-toggles><template shadowrootmode="open"><button aria-pressed="true">Bold</button><button aria-pressed="mixed">Italic</button><button aria-pressed="false">Plain</button><input type="checkbox" aria-label="Some" aria-checked="true"><input type="checkbox" aria-label="None" aria-checked="false" checked></template></ui-toggles>

pieces.name: disabled by aria-disabled above, and by a disabled fieldset
a listbox with a selected option, and a select
pieces.outline:
- listbox "Fruit":
  - option "Apple" [selected]
  - option "Pear"
- combobox "Size":
  - option "S"
  - option "M" [selected]

pieces.name: a textbox with a value and a placeholder
pieces.html: <ui-search><template shadowrootmode="open"><input type="text" aria-label="Query" placeholder="Type here" value="shoes"><input type="text" placeholder="Name"></template></ui-search>
pieces.outline:
- textbox "Query":
  - /placeholder: Type here
  - text: shoes
- textbox "Name"

pieces.name: what is not content: hidden, scripts, styles; a slot's fallback is
texts that need quotes, and names that do or do not say their text
pieces.outline:
- note: "- dash first"
- note: "true"
- note: "42"
- note: "key: value"
- button "Close dialog": Close
- button "Go": Next page
